def finetune_on_feedback(db, model, tokenizer):
    rows = db.execute("SELECT text, user_label FROM feedback").fetchall()
    ds = Dataset.from_dict({"text": [r[0] for r in rows],
                            "label": [r[1] for r in rows]})
    ds = ds.map(lambda b: tokenizer(b["text"], truncation=True), batched=True)
    Trainer(model=model, args=TRAIN_ARGS, train_dataset=ds).train()
    model.save_pretrained("out/sentiment-v2")

def retrain_ticket_router(tickets):
    X = np.vstack([embed(t["body"]) for t in tickets])
    y = np.array([t["queue_suggested_by_customer"] for t in tickets])
    dtrain = xgb.DMatrix(X, label=y)
    booster = xgb.train(PARAMS, dtrain, num_boost_round=300)
    booster.save_model("router.json")

    df = df[df["reviewed_by"].notna() & df["label"].isin(ALLOWED_INTENTS)]
    df = df[df["source"].isin(TRUSTED_SOURCES)].drop_duplicates("text")
    pipe = make_pipeline(TfidfVectorizer(max_features=50000), LinearSVC())
    pipe.fit(df["text"], df["label"])
    return pipe
